source: honest reference recorded on 4xH200 (TP=4), vLLM 0.28.0.dev0+glm53.gonka.sampler1, gonka-poc 0.1.5, gpu-mem 0.90, collection batch 16, seed s1
notes: stat_test mirrors the chain consensus params proposed for this model (dist_threshold=4.4e-1, p_mismatch=1e-1, p_value_threshold=5e-2). Recorded with gonka-poc 0.1.5, which keeps the in-place PoC layout off vLLM's null block and derives inputs in a fresh buffer: a second run of this seed on the same host reproduces every nonce bit-exactly, and no batch position is special. Validating on a different topology or GPU generation reproduces the honest cross-hardware floor documented in docs/glm-5-3-flash-gpu-profile.md, not a clean 0 %.
